word-bill-invoice.def: a paper that asks you to pay for goods or services

word-account-bank.def: an arrangement with a bank that keeps your money safe

word-account-user.def: your personal page with a username and password on a website or app

word-afternoon.def: the part of the day between lunchtime and evening

word-noon.def: twelve o'clock in the middle of the day

word-tonight.def: during the evening or night of today

word-season.def: one of the four parts of the year, such as spring or winter

word-impossible.def: not able to happen or be done

word-cool-temperature.def: a little cold, in a pleasant way

word-lucky.def: having good things happen by chance

word-sleepy.def: ready to go to sleep; tired

word-nature.def: plants, animals, weather and everything in the world not made by people

word-earth-planet.def: the planet where we live, which goes around the sun

word-both.def: used to talk about two people or things together

word-few.def: a small number of; not many

word-several.def: more than two but not a lot of

word-although.def: used to show that something is true in spite of another fact

word-while.def: during the time that something else is happening

word-than.def: a word used before the second thing when you compare two things

word-however.def: used to add a point that goes against what you just said

word-sale.def: a time when a store sells things for lower prices

word-queue.def: people standing one behind another while they wait

word-sign-notice.def: a board with words or pictures giving information or instructions

word-neighborhood.def: a part of a town where people live close together

word-new-year.def: the celebration on January 1st, the first day of the calendar

word-christmas.def: the holiday on December 25th when many people give gifts
